comparison.objective: Unmold a tart by centering its loose base on a stand and lowering the surrounding ring; candidate commissions and locks an industrial-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests level bimanual rim handling, centered support placement and symmetric lowering without touching a fragile load. Candidate tests small-tool insertion, counterholding, fine collar rotation, torque-limited locking and repeated control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires the tart/base centered and level on the stand, ring flat on the table, limited ring tilt, no tart contact/displacement, and arms clear/home. Candidate requires two safe repeatable dynamic stops within energy, velocity, stroke, rebound and lock-retention constraints.
comparison.reason: The objectives, contact regime and failure modes test meaningfully different abilities; generic bimanual coordination is the only material commonality. Both records provide detailed scoring, though the candidate leaves its final collar-drift tolerance to be declared.
